sql.feature.getAllForCompany: select cf.id, cf.feature_name, cf.company_id, cf.feature_id, cf.archived from flow.company_feature cf where cf.company_id = :companyId and cf.archived is not true
sql.feature.getAllForCompanyWithAccess: select cf.id, cf.feature_name, cf.company_id, cf.feature_id, cf.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(accessControl))) FROM ( select ac.id, ac.access_level as "accessLevel", ac.access_code as "accessCode", false as enabled from flow.access_control ac where ac.archived is not true order by ac.id ) accessControl), '[]') AS "accessControl" from flow.company_feature cf where cf.company_id = :companyId and cf.archived is not true
sql.feature.getForUser: select cf.id, cf.feature_name as "featureName", cf.company_id as "companyId", cf.feature_id as "featureId", cf.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(accessControl))) FROM ( select ufac.id, ufac.user_id as "userId", ufac.company_feature_id as "companyFeatureId", ac.id as "accessControlId", ac.access_level as "accessLevel", ac.access_code as "accessCode", ufac.enabled from flow.access_control ac left join flow.user_feature_access_control ufac on ac.id = ufac.access_control_id and ufac.company_feature_id = cf.id and ufac.user_id = :userId order by "accessControlId" ) accessControl), '[]') AS "accessControl" from flow.company_feature cf where cf.company_id = :companyId and cf.archived is not true
sql.feature.insertUserFeatureAccessControl: insert into flow.user_feature_access_control(company_feature_id, access_control_id, user_id, enabled) values (:companyFeatureId, :accessControlId, :userId, true);
sql.feature.updateUserFeatureAccessControl: update flow.user_feature_access_control set enabled = :enabled where id = :userFeatureAccessControlId
